title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 279 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 279 - Penalty for Non-compliance of Section 239 Where any person fails to file any report under Section 239, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may impose a fine not exceeding Tk 3 (three) lakhs on such person. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
